about_the_game:
Know the legend — discover how it began.
In Saci: Son of the Wind, you will experience a narrative adventure that blends historical drama, psychological horror, and Brazilian folklore into a unique and immersive journey.

The story shifts between 19th-century Brazil, amidst the violence of slavery and colonization, and the present day, where a family inheritance leads you to an old estate haunted by dark secrets. Past and present intertwine through memories, conflicts, and supernatural forces that span generations.

Gameplay

  • Atmospheric exploration in historical and contemporary settings.

  • Narrative choices that affect dialogues, relationships, and the outcome of the story.

  • Quick Time Events during moments of tension and combat.

  • Multiple endings, shaped by the player’s decisions.

Themes

A journey about identity, heritage, memory, and resistance. Uncover the echoes of a brutal past, face folkloric mysteries, and decide what legacy will remain for the future.
